subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` the canonical Chinese locale IDs across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs publishing, saved browser preferences, and app locale mappings?
rationale: The rename is technically reasonable, but it changes shipped public locale identifiers, documented CLI environment values, and persisted browser preferences, so automation should not choose the migration and alias policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-code migration
options.body: Make `zh-Hans`/`zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates generated artifacts, docs, tests, native mappings, and legacy saved/doc values intentionally.

options.title: Keep region codes public for now
options.body: Leave `zh-CN`/`zh-TW` as public OpenClaw locale IDs and optionally document script-based docs publishing metadata separately.

options.title: Split docs metadata from runtime IDs
options.body: Keep runtime and CLI IDs unchanged while limiting script-based naming to docs publishing and navigation metadata.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-code migration
recommendation.body: Make `zh-Hans`/`zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates generated artifacts, docs, tests, native mappings, and legacy saved/doc values intentionally.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses public setup behavior, docs, and migration policy, and steipete is the strongest available routing owner from the related CLI onboarding i18n history.
